skill.summary: Turn a 60-second raw video clip into 1080p edited video clips just by typing what you need. Whether it's generating CapCut-style videos with effects and text...

latestVersion.changelog:
Generator CapCut 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate CapCut-style edited videos (1080p, with effects, text, BGM) from raw clips in 30-60 seconds.
- Seamless cloud workflow: upload clip, describe your desired edits, and download the result—no manual timeline editing or export config.
- Automatic setup: creates a cloud session and acquires a free-use token if not detected.
- Supports batch and iterative editing with session state for refining results.
- Provides real-time status, credit checks, export, and troubleshooting for uploads (max 500MB, most standard formats).
- All API requests include required attribution headers for correct operation.
